current_issue: Good shell base, but route-local and diagnostic concerns are not yet clearly separated.
recommendation: Stabilize a 5-zone shell: top bar, activity rail, center workspace, inspector, diagnostics panel.
rationale: A professional product needs fixed grammar before adding more features.

current_issue: Overloaded with workspace selectors, connection state, git ref, panel toggles, focus mode and grid controls.
recommendation: Keep only global identity, status, quick switch and global actions; move route-local controls down.
rationale: Users should not parse route-local mechanics in the same visual band as product identity.

current_issue: Current core nav risks fragmenting the workflow into too many top-level destinations.
recommendation: Keep an icon-first activity rail, but simplify core task families and group core/extended/admin.
rationale: Primary navigation should reflect task model, not implementation detail.

current_issue: Status exists in more than one place but hierarchy between summary and interruptive banner can be sharpened.
recommendation: Use top bar for compact summary and banner only when action or degraded context matters.
rationale: State communication should be layered, not duplicated.

current_issue: Useful composite exists, but route-level grammar is not fully standardized around it.
recommendation: Turn ViewHeader into the canonical route header with title, subtitle, status and actions.
rationale: Shared route framing raises consistency fast with low code churn.

current_issue: Canvas is central but still behaves more like one graph route than a full workspace.
recommendation: Treat Canvas as the operational workbench entry and host contextual tabs from here.
rationale: The graph is the map; the user task extends into code, diff, artifacts and runtime.

current_issue: Strong three-pane baseline, but not yet the canonical workbench template for the product.
recommendation: Promote it to the canonical workbench shell with tab strip and diagnostics integration.
rationale: The strongest existing layout should become the product standard, not remain route-specific.

current_issue: Mixed responsibilities and raw visual styling; some controls compete with top-bar controls.
recommendation: Limit this toolbar to route-local actions and plugin toolbar slots.
rationale: Users should know whether a control affects the workspace, the route, or only the graph.

current_issue: Grid, minimap and controls are functional but still visually noisy and partly hardcoded.
recommendation: Quiet the grid, token-bridge React Flow chrome, and add saved views / frames / zones.
rationale: Large-board work needs wayfinding, not decoration.

current_issue: Explorer exists but should become a stronger task-oriented navigator for large graphs.
recommendation: Add filters, sections, recent focus points and saved views.
rationale: Large boards need secondary navigation beyond pan/zoom.

current_issue: Context surface exists but needs a clearer panel grammar and hierarchy.
recommendation: Standardize summary/runtime/sql/lineage/plugin panel order and affordances.
rationale: Context panels should answer specific questions in predictable places.

current_issue: Needs more density and a stronger list/detail or table/detail pattern.
recommendation: Move toward a split cockpit: filters, run list/table, detail, timeline, diagnostics.
rationale: Monitoring and triage work benefit from dense, comparable layouts.

current_issue: Useful bottom drawer, but too narrowly framed as a console and limited in API mode.
recommendation: Convert it into a diagnostics workspace with tabs for Events, Logs, Problems and Output.
rationale: Bottom panels should aggregate runtime signal, not be one single-purpose surface.

current_issue: Standalone route works, but breaks the natural graph-to-code workflow into another destination.
recommendation: Keep route support, but prefer contextual opening in tabs from node or run context.
rationale: Users usually want code of something, not the generic idea of a code screen.

current_issue: Good capability, but route-level separation adds context switching.
recommendation: Retain route, but move the main usage pattern toward contextual compare tabs and route header standardization.
rationale: Diff is usually subordinate to a selected artifact, node or run.

current_issue: Useful route, but still visually and structurally closer to a composed screen than a polished catalog surface.
recommendation: Adopt a left catalog + right preview grammar and unify tokens.
rationale: Artifact work benefits from stable browse/preview anatomy.

current_issue: Strong diagnostic data, but not yet productized as an extension manager.
recommendation: Convert to a searchable plugin catalog/table with details drawer and compatibility truth model.
rationale: Pluginization should be visible as product capability, not only as technical introspection.

current_issue: Tabs exist, but the surface can become denser and more operationally legible.
recommendation: Use stronger table/detail patterns and tighter route header/filter grammar.
rationale: Administrative tasks tend to be high-density and search/filter heavy.

current_issue: Excellent base, but missing richer route metadata, bottom panel hooks and command palette contributions.
recommendation: Extend the contract with route-header, command palette and diagnostics contribution surfaces.
rationale: As plugin count grows, UX docking must be explicit, not implicit.

current_issue: Technically strong, but should expose clearer grouping semantics for product navigation and workbench placement.
recommendation: Keep app-first composition and add metadata for route family, preferred dock and maturity.
rationale: The registry should drive UX consistency, not just code discoverability.

current_issue: Canvas, Lineage, Code and Diff all appear as core views, which risks over-fragmenting the primary nav.
recommendation: Keep Canvas and Lineage core; evaluate demoting Code and Diff into contextual tabs or secondary navigation.
rationale: Primary navigation should reflect task families, not every subordinate surface.

current_issue: Good runtime overlays and badges exist, but their output is still spread between routes and console.
recommendation: Extend monitoring toward diagnostics panel tabs and richer route integration.
rationale: Runtime signal should aggregate into a coherent operational story.

current_issue: Semantic token base is already good, but not yet the true authority everywhere.
recommendation: Expand semantic tokens and make views consume them consistently.
rationale: A professional theme system only works when code stops bypassing it.

current_issue: Decorative gradients and React Flow hardcodes introduce extra noise and reduce theme governability.
recommendation: Reduce decoration and convert raw values into token-driven styling.
rationale: A workbench should emphasize content surfaces over decorative atmosphere.

current_issue: Still effectively tied to a generic `vs-dark` editor identity.
recommendation: Define a stable DVT Monaco theme and align container tokens and typography.
rationale: Editor surfaces should look native to the product.

current_issue: Same theme and integration issue as the code surface.
recommendation: Apply the same DVT Monaco theme strategy and size tokens.
rationale: Diff and code need one cohesive language inside the workbench.

current_issue: Fallback container and colors are hardcoded and generic.
recommendation: Tokenize container background, border and default heights.
rationale: Fallback states should still look first-class.

current_issue: Strong persisted layout store, but it still carries `activeTabs` alongside layout concerns.
recommendation: Keep layout persistence here, but move content/workbench tab lifecycle into its own store.
rationale: Layout and content tabs are different concerns.

current_issue: Runtime mode/bootstrap config is still read at store module level.
recommendation: Move runtime mode decisions back toward a single composition boundary.
rationale: This aligns the codebase with the frontend boundary architecture goals.

current_issue: Useful persisted canvas state exists, but it does not yet model saved views or large-board navigation aids.
recommendation: Extend it with saved views, focus presets, frame visibility and selection history where appropriate.
rationale: Repeated board work depends on memory and quick recall.

current_issue: Still present as a deprecated monolithic facade.
recommendation: Do not extend it; continue the split by concern.
rationale: Professionalization requires stronger ownership boundaries, not a bigger god store.

current_issue: Current package now ships `test`, but some docs still talk as if there were no package-level test command.
recommendation: Update docs and rollout language to match the real package surface.
rationale: Product and engineering confidence depend on truthful docs.
